P1.3.text: RGC Resources is an energy services company engaged in the sale and distribution of natural gas to approximately 64,500 residential, commercial and industrial customers in Roanoke, Virginia, and the surrounding localities, through its Roanoke Gas subsidiary. In addition to Roanoke Gas, RGC Midstream is a subsidiary that invests in natural gas transportation infrastructure including the Mountain Valley Pipeline (MVP), MVP Southgate and MVP Boost.

P2.3.text: We grew up with the city.

P2.4.text: one year after Roanoke became a city, Roanoke Gas Company is proud to deliver safe, reliable, and affordable energy. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for the communities and customers we serve, and we joyfully honor that commitment every day.

P2.5.text: In those early years, gas replaced the oil and kerosene used to light the city’s streetlamps. As demand increased, we expanded to serve Salem and Vinton.

P2.6.text: Roanoke Gas Company transitioned from producing manufactured gas in local plants to tapping into natural gas pipelines throughout the region for distribution. Today, we serve more than 60,000 households, and the demand for clean, sustainable energy has never been higher.

P2.7.text: Our commitment extends beyond providing energy, though. In addition, all our officers serve on the boards of nonprofit organizations.

P2.8.text: One year after Roanoke was proclaimed a city, Roanoke Gas Company was founded by key leaders in an effort to develop the community. Founders included the first President, Peyton L. Terry, Secretary-Treasurer John H. Dunston, J.B. Austin, Alexander S. Asbury, Mortimer M. Rogers, John P. Pettyjohn, and William Welch.

P2.9.text: Roanoke City Extends Contract for 30 Years

P2.10.text: The Company’s franchise with the City of Roanoke, whose provisions included authorization for the City to purchase the gas property, was set to expire. The City chose to extend the franchise for another 30 years. With that, the leadership guided the Company through expansion and improvements.

P2.12.text: A new coal gas plant was constructed in order to provide the Gas Company with the most modern and efficient gas plant design available. The new holder was capable of storing 1,500,000 cubic feet and was at the time, one of the largest in Virginia

P2.13.text: Roanoke Gas Company Extends Service Area

P2.14.text: Gas mains are extended to Salem, Vinton, and other outlying suburbs at the time, including South Roanoke.

P2.15.text: The name of the gas company changed from Roanoke Gas Light Company to Roanoke Gas Company.

P2.16.text: Roanoke Gas Company Continues to Expand

P2.17.text: Growth continued as plans were developed to bring natural gas to Roanoke. Roanoke Gas received its certificate from the Federal Power Commission and organized the Roanoke Pipe Line Company to build a 30-mile pipeline from Gala, Virginia to Roanoke. It was completed in the late summer of 1950 and natural gas was introduced to homes and businesses. New natural gas rates were 20% lower than the manufactured gas rates and the BTU content was nearly double that of manufactured gas.

P1.1.text: Ferrellgas Propane | Local Delivery & Service for Home & Business

P1.2.text: For nearly 85 years, Ferrellgas has been serving local communities as your local propane provider. Trust us to fuel what matters to you and find the location nearest to you.

P1.3.text: Easy Propane Solutions for Homes and Businesses

P1.4.text: Ferrellgas makes propane service simple, safe, and dependable. Special offer available for new residential customers.

P1.5.text: From heating your home to fueling your business, Ferrellgas provides safe, dependable propane service when and where you need it. With propane delivery, refills, and propane-powered solutions tailored to your needs, our trained professionals make it easy to keep life running.

P1.6.text: Not every propane user is the same, and you deserve the service that fits your unique needs. Get your propane price with our instant online quote tool.

P1.7.text: From preparation to tank setting to inspection, we make the installation process easy and safe for customers and employees every step of the way.

P1.9.text: We service your area. Your local office is.

P1.10.text: Ferrellgas was as a family-owned business in a small town. The Ferrell family believed in customer service, dependability, and hard work. Now, more than 85 years later, we have transformed into an employee-owned, national company with those same family values. Our passionate professionals never stop pursuing ways to make propane simple and smooth for every customer. Recognized as one of 2025’s Most Trustworthy Companies in America by Newsweek, Ferrellgas customers, new and old, can trust our experience and expertise to Fuel Life Simply.

P1.11.text: Propane service so easy, the choice is simple.

P1.12.text: When your tank level is low, you need a provider you can trust. Our nationwide supply network has been powering America for more than 85 years and ensures access to propane when and where you need it.

P1.13.text: Whenever you have a question or need support, our team of friendly propane experts is ready to assist. Yes, even after hours with a 24/7/365 team dedicated to emergency service.

P1.14.text: We use local drivers and the latest technology to offer flexible delivery plans and efficient delivery windows. We have that too with our free Auto Fill program.

P1.15.text: I love Ferrellgas, my husband and I have been customers for 26 years. Our house is 100% propane, so we need a reliable company. Anytime we have a problem hurricane or ice storm they are always Johnny on the spot. I love Ferrellgas.

P1.16.text: It's been really great to have Ferrellgas, just as a national partner. I'm excited for my next adventure with them, just to see how we can wow a customer... and Ferrellgas is that company that can help me do that.

P1.17.text: I'd recommend Ferrellgas because they're efficient, professional, and they have a safe track record. And above all, you don't have to worry about the fuel. It'll get here without any worries.

P1.18.text: Thank you to my Ferrellgas delivery person. It is so nice to know all I need to do is just place my order and magically my gas tank is filled. Snow or bad weather doesn’t stop you and that is appreciated. Thank you again!

P1.19.text: I enjoy working with Ferrellgas because they're easy to do business with. So I highly recommend Ferrellgas. Certainly to my family, which is most precious to me–and I think that in itself says it all.

P1.20.text: I know it's no further than a phone call away to increase the amount of volume of propane that I have. There's no issues in your guys' supply chain. It's just simply something I don't have to worry about.

P1.21.text: They leave a paper for what they did for the day and sometimes we don’t
